T: Sun, sea and three possible dads. Pass the feta.
D: On a Greek island, a bride-to-be invites three men who might be her father to her wedding.
P: Serve the feast at Sophie's wedding party on the island.
S: Donna's little hotel on the island

Thick garlicky tzatziki, smoky charred eggplant dip and whipped feta with chilli, with olives and grilled pita brushed with oregano oil. Grate 1 Lebanese cucumber, squeeze dry and mix with 250g Greek yoghurt, 1 grated garlic clove, dill and lemon. Char 1 eggplant over a flame until collapsed, scoop and mash with 2 tbsp tahini, garlic, lemon and olive oil. Blend 150g feta with 3 tbsp yoghurt and top with chilli flakes. Brush 4 pita breads with oil and oregano and grill. Serve with olives.
the hen night on the terrace
Haloumi sliced and griddled until golden, drizzled with honey and thyme, a squeeze of lemon.
Rosie has just written a cookbook
Spinach, feta and dill wrapped in crisp buttered filo, the kind of recipe Rosie would sign for a villager.
M: Lamb shoulder with garlic, oregano, lemon and potatoes, wrapped in baking paper and foil, roasted at 160C for 4 hours until it falls apart.
Kalokairi charred octopus and Greek salad

Octopus simmered tender, then charred over high heat with lemon, oregano and olive oil, with a chunky Greek salad and fava dip. Simmer 1.2kg cleaned octopus in water with a bay leaf and a splash of vinegar for 50 minutes until tender, then cool in the liquid. Cut into tentacles, toss with oil and grill over high heat for 3 minutes a side until charred. Dress with lemon, olive oil and oregano. Toss tomato, cucumber, red onion, capsicum, olives and a slab of feta with oil and oregano. Serve with store-bought fava or hummus.
W: Yeasted batter spooned into hot oil, fried until puffed and golden, soaked in warm honey with cinnamon and walnuts.
K: Pepper tending bar at the Villa Donna
Ouzo poured over ice so it turns cloudy, topped with lemonade, the way it goes out over the Villa Donna bar. Minty lemonade for the kids.

s.note: the hen night on the terrace
s.how: Slice 2 blocks of haloumi about 1cm thick. Cook in a hot dry pan or griddle for 2 minutes a side until golden and marked. Lay on a plate, drizzle with honey, scatter with fresh thyme leaves and squeeze over a little lemon. Eat while hot.

s.note: Rosie has just written a cookbook
s.how: Wilt 500g spinach and squeeze dry. Mix with 250g crumbled feta, 1 egg, 3 spring onions and dill. Brush 10 sheets of filo with 100g melted butter, cut into strips, fold the filling into triangles and bake at 190C for 25 minutes.

m.how: Rub a 2kg lamb shoulder with garlic, oregano, lemon juice and olive oil. Sit on 1kg potato chunks, wrap tightly in baking paper and then foil. Roast at 160C for 4 hours until it falls apart. Open at the table so the steam rises.

w.how: Mix 250g flour, 7g yeast and 300ml warm water to a sticky batter and rest an hour until bubbly. Drop spoonfuls into hot oil and fry until puffed and golden. Toss in warm honey with a pinch of cinnamon and scatter with chopped walnuts.

d.note: Pepper tending bar at the Villa Donna
d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice. Pour 30ml ouzo into each and watch it turn cloudy, then top with 200ml cold lemonade and a mint sprig. Make the kids' glasses with lemonade and mint only.
